title: EARLY WILL I
SEEK THEE
end: The Morning Altar — begin every sunrise in prayer
stock_queries: sun rising over dewy grass morning mist
golden dawn light touching mountain peaks
morning light through bedroom window soft shadows
tranquil river at sunrise golden reflections
peaceful forest sunrise mist rising through trees
early morning sunlight warming a quiet room
vast empty landscape glowing at sunrise

scenes.a: Before the demands of this hour pull you in different directions, rest right here.
Father, before my feet touch the floor and before I look at my list of tasks, my heart turns to You.
You are my God, and I look to You alone for the strength I need to walk through today.
O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
When the world feels dry and difficult, let Your living water refresh my weary spirit.
Fill every empty place inside me this morning so I can walk in Your peace.
